title: Register user
scenario: A visitor creates an account so they can join and host sessions.
prerequisites: Configured Supabase project. Use a fresh email address for each subcase unless the case says otherwise. Start each subcase logged out.

cases.action: Complete step 1 (region, email, password), then step 2 (name, sport) and submit.
cases.inputs: West; new email; 8-character password; Marcus Lim; Badminton.
cases.expected: Either "Account created. Check your email for a confirmation link, then log in.", or signed in and taken to Home. One profile and one wallet at S$0.00 exist.
cases.actual: Signed in at once and taken to Home ("Upcoming Bookings"); production does not require email confirmation. The delete page later showed an available balance of S$0.00.

cases.action: Submit step 1 with each password separately.
cases.expected: 7 shows "Use at least 8 characters"; 73 shows "Use 72 characters or fewer"; 8 and 72 continue to step 2.
cases.actual: 7: "Use at least 8 characters"; 73: "Use 72 characters or fewer"; 8 and 72 continued to step 2. Account B was created with a 72-character password and logged in with it.

cases.action: Submit step 2 with each name separately.
cases.expected: Empty and spaces show "Enter your name"; 61 shows "Keep your name under 60 characters"; 1 and 60 are accepted.
cases.actual: Empty and spaces: "Enter your name"; 61: "Keep your name under 60 characters". 1 character (account C, "M") and 60 characters (account B) were accepted and shown in full.

cases.action: Submit step 1 with each email separately.
cases.expected: The first shows "Enter a valid email address". The second is accepted and stored in lower case.
cases.actual: not-an-email: "Enter a valid email address". A mixed-case address was accepted and the lower-case form logged in. The app does not display the stored address, so lower-case storage was confirmed only through login.

cases.action: Register again with an email already in use.
cases.expected: "An account with this email already exists." with a "Log in instead" link. No second account.
cases.actual: Shown on Create account (step 2): "An account with this email already exists." with a "Log in instead" link to /login; stayed on /register. Account A still logged in normally afterwards.

cases.action: Fill step 1, go to step 2, press Back, then forward again.
cases.expected: Every field keeps its value; nothing is submitted until Create account.
cases.actual: After Back: region, email and password kept; after Sign Up again: name and sport kept. Nothing was submitted.

cases.action: Open a private-session invitation logged out, choose Create account and finish registering.
cases.expected: After sign-in the user returns to the same invitation preview; nothing is joined automatically.
cases.actual: Tested with a group invitation link (no sessions were created). Logged out, the link went to /login?next=/groups/join/<token>; after Create account the user landed on the "Join a group" preview (1 member) and was not joined until pressing Join.

title: Authenticate user
scenario: A registered user logs in, is kept off protected pages while logged out, and returns to the page they asked for.
prerequisites: One active confirmed account, one unconfirmed account and one deleted (INACTIVE) account.

cases.action: Log in from /login.
cases.expected: Signed in and taken to Home.
cases.actual: Signed in and taken to Home ("Upcoming Bookings").

cases.action: Log in with each pair separately.
cases.expected: "Invalid email or password." for both; the page does not reveal which was wrong.
cases.actual: "Invalid email or password." for both the wrong password and the unknown email; the email field kept its value.

cases.action: Log in.
cases.expected: "Please confirm your email first, using the link we sent you."
cases.actual: Production signs new accounts in without email confirmation, so an unconfirmed account could not be produced.

cases.action: Log in.
cases.expected: Signed out again and shown "This account is no longer active."
cases.actual: Account C was deleted (X04). Its old session was signed out (/profile went to /login?next=/profile). Logging in shows "Invalid email or password." because deletion also removes the login, so "This account is no longer active." cannot be reached from the browser.

cases.action: Open each page while logged out.
cases.expected: Each redirects to /login?next=<page>; after login the user lands on that page.
cases.actual: /profile, /groups, /sessions and /wallet redirect to /login?next=<page>. /payouts redirects to /login without next (fixed in PR #98). Return after login was seen for the group invitation (R07).

cases.action: Open each page while logged out.
cases.expected: Each opens without a login.
cases.actual: /, /discover, /terms and /privacy return HTTP 200 without login. A session invitation preview was not tested because no sessions were created.

cases.action: Log in from each crafted URL.
cases.expected: Signed in and taken to Home, never to another site.
cases.actual: Both next=https://evil.example and next=//evil.example signed in and landed on the site's Home page.

title: Manage profile
scenario: A signed-in user views Settings and edits their name and preferences.
prerequisites: Active signed-in account with name Marcus Lim, Badminton and West.

cases.action: Open Settings.
cases.expected: Name, email, preferred sports and regions, reliability out of 5.0, and links to Edit profile, Email, Wallet, Payouts, Help, Terms, Privacy and Delete account.
cases.actual: Shows name, reliability "5.0 / High", sessions joined, attendance rate, preferred sports and regions. Links: Edit profile, Transaction history (/wallet), Privacy, Help, Terms, Delete account. The email address is not shown, and Email and Payouts are not linked from Settings (Email is reached from Help).

cases.action: Change the profile and save.
cases.inputs: Name Alex Tan; Tennis and Futsal; East.
cases.expected: Returned to Settings showing the new values; reloading keeps them.
cases.actual: Returned to Settings showing Alex Tan, Futsal and Tennis, East; reloading kept them.

cases.action: Save each name separately.
cases.expected: Empty and spaces show "Enter your name"; 61 shows "Keep your name under 60 characters"; 60 is saved.
cases.actual: Empty and spaces: "Enter your name"; 61: "Keep your name under 60 characters" (each with "Please fix the highlighted fields.") and nothing saved; 60 characters saved.

cases.action: Untick every sport, then separately every region, and save.
cases.expected: "Choose at least one sport" or "Choose at least one region"; nothing saved.
cases.actual: "Choose at least one sport" and "Choose at least one region"; the saved profile was unchanged.

cases.action: Open Email, then resend the confirmation link.
cases.expected: Status shows unconfirmed and a new link is sent; changing an existing address is not offered.
cases.actual: The email page shows "Your email address is verified." No resend is offered because production confirms addresses at sign-up, so an unconfirmed address could not be tested.

cases.action: Turn Push notifications on, then off.
cases.inputs: Browser that supports push; then one that blocks it.
cases.expected: The setting applies to this browser only; a blocked browser shows that it is blocked in browser settings.
cases.actual: Headless Chromium shows "Session notifications: Not available in this browser". A push-capable browser and a blocked browser were not available in the test environment.

cases.action: Open Help and expand each question.
cases.expected: Each answer opens; links go to Discover, Wallet, Payouts, Settings, Email, Delete account, Terms and Privacy.
cases.actual: All 10 answers open with the mouse. Links: Settings, Discover, Wallet, Email, Delete account, Terms, Privacy. The Payouts link is missing on production (added in PR #98). Keyboard use was not exercised.

title: Delete account
scenario: A user deletes their account only after every obligation is finished.
prerequisites: Separate accounts for each obligation: available balance, held share, active commitment, unsettled hosted session, pending payout, unarchived owned group; plus one account with nothing outstanding.

cases.action: Open Delete account for each prepared account.
cases.expected: The matching blocker is listed with its count or S$ amount; the delete button is not offered.
cases.actual: Owned groups: "Groups you own that aren't archived 2" with the full refusal message, and no delete button; still listed after archiving one; the delete button appeared after archiving both. Balance and commitment blockers need money or sessions, which were not created.

cases.action: Open Delete account.
cases.inputs: Account with a balance, a commitment and an owned group.
cases.expected: All three blockers are listed together, in the order shown on the page.
cases.actual: Needs a wallet balance and a commitment; no money or sessions were created on production.

cases.action: Open Delete account.
cases.expected: "Add an email address before deleting your account."
cases.actual: Every browser sign-up requires an email, so an account without one cannot be produced from the browser.

cases.action: Confirm "Yes, delete my account".
cases.expected: Logged out; the login page shows "Your account has been deleted." Name, email and preferences are removed; ledger rows remain.
cases.actual: Accounts C, A and B were deleted. The dialog showed "Wallet balance you would forfeit S$0.00"; afterwards /login?deleted=1 showed "Your account has been deleted." and the old session was signed out. The group member list shows "Deleted user" in place of the name. Ledger rows were not inspected (no database access).

cases.action: Log in with the deleted account's old credentials.
cases.expected: Login is refused (see L02/L04).
cases.actual: Login as deleted account C is refused with "Invalid email or password."

cases.action: Top up between opening the page and confirming.
cases.expected: Deletion is refused with "You must complete your active sessions, use or withdraw your remaining funds, and archive any groups you own before deleting your account." The account stays active; reloading lists the new balance.
cases.actual: Needs a top-up or commitment to land while the delete page is open; no money or sessions were created on production.

title: Manage group
scenario: A user creates a regular group, shares its link, manages members and archives it.
prerequisites: Owner and second signed-in user. A group with a linked session that is not settled, for the archive case.

cases.action: Create a group.
cases.expected: The group page opens with the owner as the only member and an active invitation link.
cases.actual: The group page opened at /groups/<id> with Members (1), the owner, and an active invitation link with Copy link, Make a new link and Turn link off.

cases.action: Create and rename with each name separately.
cases.expected: Empty and spaces show "Enter a group name"; the name field holds at most 60 characters; 60 is accepted.
cases.actual: Empty and spaces: "Enter a group name". The name field holds at most 60 characters, so typing 61 kept 60; renaming to 60 characters showed "Group name saved."

cases.action: Second user opens the link and joins.
cases.expected: Preview shows the group name; after joining both users see two members.
cases.actual: Preview: "You have been invited to Lab4 Friday Badminton, 1 member"; after Join, the group page showed Members (2) to both the member and the owner.

cases.action: Second user opens the same link again.
cases.expected: "You're already a member of this group." No duplicate member.
cases.actual: "You're already a member of this group." with Open group; the preview still showed 2 members.

cases.action: Owner turns the link off, then on again; open the old link.
cases.expected: "This invitation link is invalid or has been turned off. Ask the group owner for a new one." The new link works.
cases.actual: With the link off, the old link showed "This invitation link is invalid or has been turned off. Ask the group owner for a new one." Turning it on gave a different link; the old one stayed rejected and the new one let account B join (Members (3)).

cases.action: Second user tries to rename, remove a member or archive.
cases.expected: Controls are not offered; a direct request gets "Only the group owner can do that."
cases.actual: A member sees only Copy link: no rename, link, remove or archive controls. A direct request to an owner action was not sent from the browser.

cases.action: Attempt to remove the owner.
cases.expected: "The group owner can't be removed."
cases.actual: The owner's row has no Remove button; other members' rows do. The server message is covered by the unit tests only.

cases.action: Archive each group.
cases.inputs: Group with an unsettled linked session; group without one.
cases.expected: First: "This group still has sessions that aren't settled, so it can't be archived yet." Second: archived, link off, no further changes.
cases.actual: Group without sessions: "Archive this group?" dialog; afterwards marked Archived with no controls and no invitation link. The unsettled-session half was not run (no sessions created).
